rasg_029_final_convergence_resolution.summary: The remaining root groups are no longer treated as unknown directory clutter. They are intentionally classified as control-plane source, Prism evidence layer, Layer A compatibility and workspace-local state. They remain release-sensitive, but their presence is now explained, package-bounded and reviewable.
why_not_physically_moved_in_rasg_029: control-plane source split affects runtime/public maintainer profile
Prism raw evidence cleanup can destroy replay and review evidence if done without retention proof
Layer A loom is a product-scope decision
workspace-local state is not source material and should be excluded rather than moved into public structure
rasg_029_final_convergence_resolution.completion_boundary: RASG-029 closes the non-release confusion about why these groups remain visible. It does not close the formal release profile decisions that may later move, hide, archive or remove some of them.

keep_at_root_boundaries.reason: README.md and ARCHITECTURE.md are intentionally small root entry points for humans and should not be hidden before product packaging.
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md and SKILL.md are host discovery entry files; they must remain thin root adapters.
bin, runtime, revive-cap.sh and closeout-cap.sh are the installable runtime facade and root compatibility surface.
package.json, .npmignore and .gitignore are tooling contracts and should stay at root.

deferred_root_groups.deferral_reason: Project assets now live under assets/, but compass/tools and contracts still contain source-level control-plane code and package-visible readiness support. Collapsing those source layers requires a separate runtime/maintainer profile decision.
deferred_root_groups.revisit_trigger: Before formal release readiness if the public runtime profile is still too maintainer-heavy, or when RASG-020 contract-boundary work starts.
deferred_root_groups.future_gate: Separate apply tranche with dry-run manifest, consumer matrix, alias/rollback plan, package-safety proof, clean-workspace E2E, Prism review and closeout receipt.
deferred_root_groups.package_safety: Do not include new internal/control-plane paths in public package until runtime-public-contract-policy explicitly classifies the profile.
deferred_root_groups.archaeology_rule: Existing compass/docs, compass/knowledge and references anchors remain valid through compatibility shims; future source-layer moves must add alias resolver entries before path changes.
deferred_root_groups.closeout_rule: Cannot be declared physically consolidated by this receipt.

deferred_root_groups.deferral_reason: Prism mixes executable protocol, provider policy, reports and run evidence. Splitting it safely requires evidence-retention and provider-routing review in the same tranche.
deferred_root_groups.revisit_trigger: When Prism evidence lifecycle or provider governance needs a physical split beyond current policy/index controls.
deferred_root_groups.future_gate: Separate Prism evidence split task with retention policy, report index migration, compatibility aliases, Prism self-review and clean workspace E2E.
deferred_root_groups.package_safety: Keep prism/tools and prism/README package inclusion governed by runtime-package-readiness-policy; raw prism/runs remains ignored runtime evidence.
deferred_root_groups.archaeology_rule: Do not bulk-read or bulk-move prism/runs; formal reports and run IDs must remain resolvable through prism/reports/index.yaml.
deferred_root_groups.closeout_rule: Cannot be declared physically split by this receipt.

deferred_root_groups.deferral_reason: loom preserves Layer A compatibility and old dispatcher material. Moving it requires a product decision about whether Layer A remains part of public RedCap.
deferred_root_groups.revisit_trigger: When Layer A compatibility is product-scoped for runtime/CLI release or explicitly retired.
deferred_root_groups.future_gate: Separate Layer A boundary task with compatibility tests, host-entry review and rollback.
deferred_root_groups.package_safety: No package-surface change is allowed here without runtime contract review.
deferred_root_groups.archaeology_rule: Keep old Layer A paths as historical anchors until a dedicated compatibility decision exists.
deferred_root_groups.closeout_rule: Cannot be declared physically migrated by this receipt.

deferred_root_groups.deferral_reason: Workspace-local files include live task state, local secrets, scratch buffers and host mirrors. They are not product source and must not be normalized into public package structure.

deferred_root_groups.future_gate: Package safety and workspace-boundary checks must prove local state is excluded, not moved into public source.
deferred_root_groups.package_safety: These paths must remain unpublished; .env and scratch files are never package candidates.
deferred_root_groups.archaeology_rule: Current task state may be replaced by future runtime state, but local-only files must not become shared knowledge.
deferred_root_groups.closeout_rule: Cannot be declared physically consolidated by this receipt.

global_future_apply_gate.formal_release_hard_gate: As of P4-2m, remaining historical assets and high-risk deferred groups are release blockers until a later safe tranche resolves them or classifies them as nonhistorical local state with package exclusion proof. This receipt can preserve archaeology before formal release, but it cannot be used as a public-release-ready greenlight.
